text:
Mike: Heads up — spotted an inconsistency between the per-route permission scopes the Console shows and what the auth service actually returns after yesterday's rollout. :eyes:
Tara: oh nice catch. what specifically is mismatched?
Mike: Console shows `write:routes` for the /v1/ingest route, but auth service returns only `read:routes` for the same role. Users getting 403s in the canary group.
Sasha: hmm, that smells like a sync bug between our scope cache and the auth backend. Did the rollout change scope normalization?
Mike: I dug in. The API now returns scoped namespaced entries like `routes.ingest:write` instead of `write:routes`. Our UI matcher still expects the old format.
Tara: ugh. So two problems: parsing format in the Console, and telemetry/alerts didn't flag the mismatch. Can we add a safeguard for format changes?
Sasha: quick patch idea: update UI matcher to accept both `write:routes` and `routes.ingest:write`. I'll open a tiny PR to normalize on read.
Celine: we should also add an audit event when the Console receives a scope format it doesn't recognize. Right now it silently shows the closest match which is misleading.
Mike: agreed. Add an alert that triggers when more than 1% of auth responses include an unknown scope shape during a deployment window.
Tara: For immediate mitigation, can we fallback to checking route-level permissions server-side before rendering the action buttons? If backend says no, hide edit/delete buttons.
Sasha: we already have that data via the permissions-check endpoint, but it's expensive to hit for every row. Might add cheap caching for 30s for canary traffic.
Mike: here's the snippet I used to reproduce the mismatch in curl:```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://auth.internal/api/v1/roles/role-123/scopes | jq
# returns ["routes.ingest:write","routes.ingest:read"]
```
Celine: and Console does:```js
// old matcher
const permissionShape = scope.split(':');
// expects [write, routes]
```
Tara: That explains it. Long-term we should define a canonical scope schema and version it. Add `scope_version` on role metadata so UI and services can assert compatibility.
Sasha: agree. I'll add compatibility checks and a migration plan to the rollout playbook. Also adding a telemetry metric `console.scope_parse_failures` with tags `env` and `deployment_id`.
Mike: important for enterprise customers too — audit logs must reflect the exact scope strings we evaluated. Otherwise compliance teams will get confused.
Celine: will update audit schema to include `raw_scopes` array and `normalized_scopes` array plus `scope_schema_version` for each evaluation event.
Tara: who's owning the hotfix for the UI?
Sasha: I'll ping in a PR in 10m and cut a patch release. Planning to: normalize incoming scopes, add a visible warning pill on the role detail page if any raw scope couldn't be parsed, and emit the telemetry metric.
Mike: ops-bot, please annotate the deployment and mute alerts for the next 15m while we deploy patch to canary.
ops-bot: Deployment annotated by Sasha for canary. Alerts muted for 15m. :white_check_mark:
Celine: also need a DB backfill to rewrite legacy `write:routes` entries into namespaced format for consistency?
Tara: prefer not to mass-rewrite; instead add a compatibility layer that reads both shapes and writes in the canonical shape on update. Backfill can be opt-in.
Sasha: noted. I'll include the compatibility layer in the patch and an opt-in backfill job in the migrations repo.
Mike: timeline?
Sasha: patch -> canary in 30m, full rollout if metrics look good in 2h. I'll post updates here.
Tara: also file a short RFC for `scope_schema` and `scope_version` so product + security can comment.
Celine: created RFC draft: https://redwood/notes/scope-schema-rfc (WIP).
Mike: thanks all. Great catch and quick plan. :thumbsup:
Sasha: PR: https://git.redwood/console/merge/4527 (WIP) — will update status.
ops-bot: Canary deployment started for console-ui v1.24.3-canary.
Mike: seeing a few parse-failures metric spikes in the dashboard now, exactly where expected. Sasha please confirm logs include raw scope arrays for the affected requests.
Sasha: logs include raw_scopes and scope_schema_version now. pushing small tweak to include `deployment_id`.
Tara: sounds good. after rollout, let's add an automated regression test in the e2e suite that simulates both scope shapes.
Celine: note for the compliance doc: update how audit logs display role changes and scope evaluations.
Mike: closing loop — when full rollout completes, pls drop a short post in #product-announce for enterprise PMs to review change.
Sasha: will do. Deploying patch to canary now.
ops-bot: Canary deployment successful. Monitoring for 2 hours. :rocket: 
Celine: thanks team — great cross-discipline response.
Sasha: patch merged, follow-ups opened for RFC and backfill.
Mike: thread resolved, will reopen if anything else pops up.
